earlierCheckNotes: Initial lint found only three test-array constructor style findings; final lint passed after using Array.from.
Initial dry-run rejected the worktree ext/lib symlink; a real worktree-local generated directory fixed the environment, and final dry-run passed. No WASM source, artifact or build guard was changed.

findings: Timing schedules contain 26 observations: 17 A and 9 B, eight adjacent candidate pairs with reversed order between replications, and four separate A/A controls.
Memory schedules ABCDDCBA/CDABBADC contain two reversed four-arm blocks; B/A, C/B, D/B, C/A and D/A contrast arithmetic has correct arm denominators.
Package-rule edges cover every arm; B/C/D must retain identical physical probes, A/B permits only previously verified reference offsets/raw previews/derived counters.

All observations require complete public semantic equality and restart readback; preview counters are recomputed. Failed memory observations retain the complete fixed schedule and suppress block comparisons.
independentStudyReview.integrationFollowUp: The initial declared observer-rule string differed from SIBLING_RECOVERY_RULE; root fixed the import before publication and is adding returned schema/rule assertions. New observer proof remains under separate pre-freeze review.

findings: Admission is atomic and ordered before source dispatch. Later smaller groups cannot consume the capacity needed by an earlier required group.

All bank estimates in a group are summed; estimates are already validated nonnegative safe integers under the existing total-source cap. Zero estimates retain the same rule and can only overshoot through already admitted work.
An indivisible oversized group is admitted only at the current sink frontier with zero charged bytes. Completed oversized output blocks later admission until drain.

Each worker owns at most one reservation. Result publication replaces it with exact owned backing-buffer bytes without awaiting; source/worker/validation/cancellation failure retires the outstanding reservation exactly once.
Owned bytes remain charged through the ordered callback finally block. Empty results retire reservations without creating sink calls.
Borrowed results continue to wait for the existing idempotent consumption acknowledgment; they contribute zero owned bytes and preserve reusable-WASM-heap lifetime.
Terminal failure wakes byte waiters, observes outstanding worker loops, releases borrowed acknowledgments, preserves the first error and waits for an already-admitted sink callback.
Pool disposal remains drain-only rather than implicit cancellation: it waits for a successful active run before retiring workers.
ZIP source prefetch, retained WASM heaps, compression buffers and downstream storage are unchanged and excluded from this accounting. This is not a whole-import/RSS ceiling.
